Description: Optional YAML file containing custom PyPSA LineType definitions under a top-level line_types key. Entries are loaded before inline line_types and can be referenced by ac_types and dc_types.

Values: Mapping from custom line type name to PyPSA LineType fields: f_nom, r_per_length, x_per_length, c_per_length, i_nom, and optional mounting, cross_section, references
Description: Adds project-specific line types to the PyPSA network before ac_types/dc_types are resolved. This is useful when regional voltage levels or conductor assumptions are not included in PyPSA's built-in standard line types.

Values: Values should specify a [line type in PyPSA](https://pypsa.readthedocs.io/en/latest/components.html#line-types) for AC lines. Keys should specify the corresponding voltage level (e.g. 220., 300. and 380. kV)
Description: Specifies line types to assume for the different voltage levels of the target region. Should normally handle voltage levels 220, 300, and 380 kV.

Values: Values should specify a [line type in PyPSA](https://pypsa.readthedocs.io/en/latest/components.html#line-types) for DC-lines. Keys should specify the corresponding voltage level (e.g. 220., 300. and 380. kV)

Description: Correction factor for line capacities (``s_nom``) to approximate :math:`N-1` security and reserve capacity for reactive power flows
Global upper limit for the maximum capacity of each extendable line.
Global lower limit for the maximum capacity of each extendable line.
Correction factor to account for the fact that buses are *not* connected by lines through air-line distance.

Values: One of {'zero': set capacity to zero, 'remove': remove completely, 'keep': keep with full capacity}
Description: Specifies how to handle lines which are currently under construction.
